description: A declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

highlights: This file is the one agent instruction file for the repo (Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and Claude Code all read a root `AGENTS.md`). assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
